query: What drives praise and complaints in Amazon reviews?

per_column.name: primary_domain
per_column.rationale: Product category is context/segmentation, not a driver aspect of praise or complaint. It classifies WHAT is reviewed, not WHY it is praised or criticized.

per_column.name: quality_or_durability_issue
per_column.rationale: Product quality/durability is a genuine constitutive aspect of what drives complaints (and its absence, praise).

per_column.name: works_as_intended
per_column.rationale: Functional performance / whether the product works is a core aspect of praise/complaint drivers, distinct from build quality.

per_column.name: value_for_money
per_column.rationale: Price/value is a legitimate constitutive dimension driving satisfaction and dissatisfaction.

per_column.name: expectation_alignment
per_column.rationale: Whether the product met/exceeded/fell short of expectations is a facet of drivers, though it partly overlaps with performance and value as a summary judgment.

per_column.name: recommendation_stance
per_column.rationale: Recommend vs discourage is an OUTCOME/summary of overall sentiment, essentially restating the praise/complaint valence rather than a constitutive driver of it.

judge.rationale: Four of six columns are true facets of the drivers concept: quality/durability, functional performance, value, and expectation alignment. However mutual exclusivity is imperfect because expectation_alignment is a composite summary that overlaps with performance and value, and works_as_intended vs quality_or_durability_issue partly co-vary. primary_domain is segmentation (irrelevant to drivers) and recommendation_stance restates the overall praise/complaint outcome rather than decomposing its drivers. Exhaustiveness is moderate: important driver facets like customer service/shipping/seller experience, usability/ease of use, aesthetics, and content/subjective enjoyment (highly relevant given book/music/movie dominance) are absent, so the set does not fully cover the concept's constitutive aspects.
